system.description: ●● Combat Tool: Your character has studied extensively in akashayana Do, magical swords, hypertech gun, ecstatic dance or in another skill that can be used as a magickal tool. This allows her to use combat techniques as Tools for instant spells. When taking this Merit, choose a Skill, which your character must have three or more dots in. This Merit allows use of that Skill in combat as a Tool, adding dice to a spell cast on subsequent turns, or to a spell cast reflexively in the same turn as the combat action. You may purchase this Merit multiple times to reflect the other styles.
